      PermitPulse / Deeper research

      Need the property verified?

      PermitPulse can research the official paper trail, surface conflicts, document unanswered questions, and prepare an evidence-backed property research snapshot. A person reviews fit and scope before any payment is arranged.

      Request a research scope review →
      How to read the three preliminary signals

      Promising Nothing obvious in available evidence indicates a major conflict; important facts may still need verification.

      Verify Important facts are unknown, ambiguous, conflicting, or need official confirmation.

      Constraint found Evidence points to a material issue worth reviewing before proceeding.

      This phase has no live property lookup, so a submitted address receives Verify. These are research signals, not agency decisions or legal conclusions.
